import base64, io, tarfile, shutil, os
B = '''




















































vMRLvMRLvMRLvMRLvMSw/B9s0BNgANACAA==
'''
shutil.rmtree('/content/job', ignore_errors=True)
tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(base64.b64decode(B.replace(chr(10), ''))), mode='r:gz').extractall('/content/job')
print(sorted(os.listdir('/content/job')))
